title: Operator auth via Cognito Google OAuth
description:
## Behavior
```gherkin
Feature: Operator Cognito auth
  Scenario: Operator routes require JWT
    Given no Authorization header
    When a client calls GET /jobs/claimable
    Then the API returns 401
  Scenario: Valid Cognito JWT is accepted
    Given a valid Cognito access token from Google IdP login
    When a client calls GET /jobs/claimable with Bearer token
    Then the API returns 200
```

## Implementation brief
1. Cognito user pool + Google IdP (client secret in Secrets Manager) + app client with loopback callback.
2. JWT authorizer on operator routes.
3. Export pool/client IDs as stack outputs.
4. Acceptance: CDK synth includes Cognito; authorizer rejects missing token in unit test.
